title: ChilizJackpotPool
tagline: ChilizJackpotPool is a decentralized pool betting platform powered by smart contracts on the Chiliz blockchain. Spice up your crypto game by placing bets and stand a chance to win big in a fun and secure environment.
description:
ChilizJackpotPool is a decentralized pool betting platform powered by smart contracts on the Chiliz blockchain. Spice up your crypto game by placing bets and stand a chance to win big in a fun and secure environment.

Working: 
1. Connect your Chiliz-compatible wallet.
2. Enter the pool by placing a bet of at least 0.1 CHZ.
3. Wait for the manager to roll the spicy dice and pick the winner!
4. If you win, the entire pot will be a spicy treat for your wallet!
how_its_made:
This partner technologies use are chiliz blockchain, walletconnect, Arbitrum Stylus blockchain, Gnosis chain.
For the frontend React js, css, html are used.
The project is deployed on vercel.
The smartcontract have been deployed on chiliz blockchain, Arbitrum Stylus blockchain, Gnosis chain.
